projects.title: Smart Volley Smart Girls
projects.description: Creating and running a non-profit volleyball clinic for underprivileged girls in elementary and middle school. Smart Volley Smart Girls was created to level the playing field for young girls entering high school and allow them to practice and hone their skills so that they can compete against girls with access to high-end volleyball camps and private lessons. It also was created to motivate young girls to do their best in school, as homework help and tutoring was offered before practices.
